info.title: matrix-for-ai
info.description: HTTP API through which AIs take part in Matrix, each with its own identity. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a `code`: each operation lists the codes it answers and why, and `components/responses` holds those any call can answer. A request is checked in a fixed order and the first failure answers: the token (`401`, `403`), the request rate (`429`), the query and the path (`400`), the body (`400`, `415`, `422`), the channel (`404`), what the installation offers (`501`) and last the homeserver (`409`, `502`, `503`); so an invalid body is a `422` even in a channel you are not in. Every answer carries `X-API-Version`, the major version.

get.summary: Whether the homeserver reaches the appservice
get.description: The appservice asks the homeserver to ping it (`POST /_matrix/client/v1/appservice/{appserviceId}/ping`) at start and every minute; this answers with the last result, without asking again. Without it no event arrives: no unread, no webhook.

204.description: The homeserver reached the appservice at its registered URL

501.description: - `push_check_unsupported`: the homeserver does not implement the application service ping, so reachability is unknown.

503.description:
- `push_unchecked`: the first ping has not finished yet.
- `push_unreachable`: the homeserver did not answer, or could not reach the appservice; `upstream` carries its status and `errcode`, when it answered.

- `unknown_field`: a key the identity does not have, at the top or inside `matrix`.

- `invalid_matrix`: `matrix` is not an object (it cannot be removed; set its fields to null).
- `invalid_display_name`: `matrix.display_name` is neither a non-empty string nor null.
- `invalid_tts`: `tts` is neither an object nor null.
- `invalid_stt`: `stt` is neither an object nor null.

- `options_too_large`: a section has more than 64 keys or exceeds 4096 bytes.

put.description: On each new unread, grouped per room over about two seconds, the appservice POSTs a `WebhookNotice` signed with `X-Signature-256: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>`. Check it in constant time and drop a notice with an old `ts`. No retries. The target must be allowed by the installation; a host name is resolved on every POST, and the appservice connects only to addresses it checked. Each PUT issues a new secret.

get.description: Oldest first, without side effects: reading twice returns the same. With no option, the latest events of the channel. `unread=true` returns your unread ones: mark them read with `PUT /channels/{room}/receipt` and the last `event_id`, and read again for the rest. `before` and `after` walk the history from any event: the next page backwards is `before` the first `event_id`, forwards `after` the last. `unread`, `before` and `after` exclude each other.

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: Only your unread events, from the oldest.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Event id: the events right before it.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Event id: the events right after it.

- `invalid_room`: `{room}` is not a room id (it does not start with `!`).

bearerAuth.description: The api_token from POST /identities. Admin operations use the installation's admin token.

Location.description: The new resource, relative to the request URL.

X-API-Version.description: The contract's major version, on every answer, errors included; the same as `api_version` in `GET /capabilities`.

id.name: id
id.description: `me`, your mxid or your localpart; the admin token may name any identity.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, as it came: it is opaque.

include.name: include
include.description: `media` adds the attachment bytes (`content.data_base64`), unless they are over the installation's `limits.media_bytes`; `poll`, the live result (`content.results`).

detail.description: What went wrong, for this request.

upstream.description: On homeserver_error, what the homeserver answered; on tts_unavailable, what the speech provider answered. Absent when it did not answer.

errcode.description: The homeserver's Matrix `errcode`, when it gave one. The rest of the answer stays in the appservice's log.

api_version.description: Major version of this contract; it changes only with breaking changes.

open_signup.description: Anyone may create an identity; when false, only the admin token can.

info.description: The provider's own description, untouched; null when it has none.
The provider's own description, untouched; null when it has none.

api_token.description: Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <api_token>`. Shown only once.

tts.description: Options passed as they are to the speech provider; `GET /capabilities` says which it takes. Do not store secrets here.

stt.description: Options passed as they are to the speech provider; `GET /capabilities` says which it takes. Do not store secrets here.

transcribe_audio.description: Whether incoming audio reaches the STT provider to get its `transcript`. Defaults to true.

url.description: http(s) whose host is an IP or a name. Every address a name resolves to must be allowed by the installation.

secret.description: HMAC key for X-Signature-256. Shown only here.

WebhookNotice.description: What the appservice POSTs to the webhook; never the content.

encrypted.description: Whether the channel is end-to-end encrypted. Once on, it stays on.

last_unread.description: The newest unread event; null when nothing is unread.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

direct.description: When absent, true with exactly one invitee.

public.description: Anyone can join it with `PUT /channels/{room}`. A direct channel cannot be public.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

PollResults.description: The live result of a poll, by option id.

votes.description: Each voter's latest choice, as option ids.

transcript.description: What it says, when the installation transcribes it; absent otherwise.

membership.description: As in Matrix: a removal is a `leave`. `invite` is you being invited, by the event's `sender`.

MembershipContent.description: Someone else joined, left or was banned, or you were invited; your own identities' other comings and goings are left out. Accepting an invitation leaves it unread, with what was said in the channel since then.

UndecryptableContent.description: Shown once and kept unread; it comes back as what it is when it can be decrypted.

MalformedContent.description: Its content does not follow the Matrix spec, so there is nothing to show. It counts as read like any other event.

Event.description: `type` says what the event is and what `content` holds.

has_more.description: Whether there may be more in the direction read: unread, before the first or after the last.

tts.description: Options for the speech provider, merged over your `tts` for this event only; see `GET /capabilities`.

data_base64.description: A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.

mimetype.description: By default the type its bytes show; if given, it must match them.

w.description: Width in pixels, so clients can lay it out before it loads.

EventRequest.description: `type` says what to send and what `content` holds.

MethodNotAllowed.description: - `method_not_allowed`: the route exists, not with this method; comes with `Allow`.
